title: Claimant and CSR UI smoke tests plus a11y check
story: Playwright smoke coverage and accessibility warnings for Sprint 1 apps
acceptance: node --test tests/ui/claimant.test.mjs passes or skips cleanly: Aurelia personal auto glass guided intake to claim number and status page
Spanish toggle shows Spanish labels; Kestrel branding differs from Aurelia
node --test tests/ui/csr.test.mjs passes or skips cleanly: CSR login, policy lookup, assisted intake submit

src/web/shared/a11y-check.js exports a pure/DOM-run check for input labels, img alt, landmarks, brand-token color contrast (WCAG ratio); results reported as warnings (console/test diagnostics), not failures
node --test tests/unit/web/shared/a11y-check.test.mjs passes on fixture HTML and contrast math
No edits to src/web/claimant or src/web/csr; any real bug reported in result and posted as blocker to experience hub
brief: Write tests only; read src/web/claimant and src/web/csr read-only to learn selectors, routes and flows. Boot createApp on port 0 against temp db with real tenants and modules; seed policies via ctx.forTenant(t).modules.coverage.seedPolicies(generatePolicies(...)) from tests/synthetic; keep the boot helper in tests/ui/a11y-harness.mjs (own copy; other tickets have theirs). Load playwright via createRequire resolving from /opt/node-tools/node_modules; t.skip cleanly if import or browser launch fails. a11y-check.js: framework-free functions taking a Document/root element (so it runs both in the browser via page.evaluate with the function source and in node unit tests with simple string parsing or a minimal fake DOM) plus contrastRatio(hex,hex) and checkTokens(tokensObject) for foreground/background brand pairs read from tenant branding and src/web/shared/tokens.css; require 4.5:1 for text. Report findings as warnings with t.diagnostic and console.warn; never fail on them. Claimant flow: choose Aurelia, pick personal auto glass, fill steps with synthetic policy data, submit, assert claim number format and status page. Spanish: toggle locale and assert a known Spanish label from the i18n dictionaries. Kestrel: compare brand name or CSS custom property to Aurelia's. CSR: dev login as csr, look up a seeded policy, run assisted intake to submit. If you find a genuine bug, mark that assertion with a clear message, post a blocker: AGENT_ID=ic-experience-accessibility-specialist node org/cli.mjs post experience blocker "..." --ticket S2-EXP-03, and describe it in your result. Run only your tests. Do not git commit.

verdicts.reason: 15 runnable tests pass, 4 TODO for app bugs reported as blockers; criteria met (glass flow uses auto-general due to blocker 2); no app edits seen
